description:
Catalog entry locating one periodic engine checkpoint in the binary checkpoint member.

The frame holds the checkpointed state's record and an exact libghostty-vt engine snapshot.

event_seq.description: Canonical event responsible for the checkpointed state.

length.description: Compressed byte length of that frame.

monotonic_ns.description: Monotonic timestamp of the checkpointed state in nanoseconds.

offset.description: Byte offset of the checkpoint's zstd frame in the binary checkpoint member.

title: SemanticReplayCheckpoint
